risk: Retiring callable legacy test surfaces can break undocumented consumers that invoked those paths directly.
Changing all rule evidence bindings requires current migration seals; stale pre-rebinding hashes must fail closed.
The focused scenario chain must retain positive and near-negative observability without restoring the full legacy suite.
Skill-only release paths must remain confined to the candidate without being mistaken for mathematical-modeling project artifacts.
old_behavior: The V14 release gate hard-coded its release identity, driver IDs, driver count, scripts, and required scenario IDs.
Maintenance evidence depended on same-source atomic oracles, fixed-version corpus checks, and a V10 single-operation change envelope.
The release manifest schema still identified V12 even after later candidate generations.
The shared path preflight applied project-platform roles to a Skill release ChangeSet and blocked creation of the frozen manifest inside the candidate.
new_observable_effects: The release gate reads active drivers, scripts, timeouts, and required case IDs from the current release policy and verifies an exact plan mirror.
The contracts driver directly checks current atom owners, route reachability, capability packets, runtime near-negatives, and reviewed migration strength.
The package, state, plan, manifest schema, gate report, and freeze output share the V15.0.0 identity.
Skill-only ChangeSets admit only relative paths contained by the candidate root, while project ChangeSets continue to use the project-platform role contract.
preserved: The release control plane remains three focused drivers executed once each in fresh subprocesses.
All 51 inherited capabilities and nine grouped V11-V14 native control capabilities remain bound to current owners and evidence.
G0-G3 proportional activation, exact evidence invalidation, canonical platform admission, state lifecycle, Skill authorization, and R1 recovery remain active.
Project file creation remains fail-closed against canonical project-platform roles; the exemption is limited to isolated Skill maintenance.
The human-reviewed V15 regression case registry remains a current routing input to the active scenarios driver.
retired_or_merged: The V10 change-envelope, generated atomic oracle, fixed-version corpus, superseded broad-harness executables, and superseded versioned release-driver stacks are retired.
Still-useful negative invariants and preservation checks are merged into the V15 contracts driver; observable project outcomes are merged into the V15 scenarios driver.
Historical prose and lineage stay available as audit evidence but do not remain callable compatibility interfaces.
unverified: The local gate does not prove arbitrary mathematical or empirical correctness.
External services, unregistered downstream consumers, and operating systems other than the release host remain outside this gate.
Human judgment remains responsible for the truth and sufficiency of domain evidence and for the semantic accuracy of this review.

impact_surfaces.effect: Migrate candidate, plan, state, gate, freeze, and manifest schema to one V15 identity.
Bind current rules directly to stable V15 inventory and preservation checks.
Retain total action/tier/event witnesses and the lightweight near-negative runtime boundary set.
Keep Skill release paths inside the isolated candidate without applying project artifact roles or weakening project path admission.
Require every active capability to be reachable through a registered packet or explicit machine-contract boundary.
Use curated disposable project cases for platform, identity, recovery, receipt, pause, manuscript, visual, and modeling outcomes.
Retire obsolete executables while retaining one externally bound pre-release checkpoint identity.

rollback_identity.strategy: Publish only to a new destination; if release acceptance fails, keep the V15 destination absent and restore from the externally retained pre-release checkpoint.

unverified_boundaries: The gate proves declared local contracts and representative filesystem outcomes, not arbitrary mathematical correctness.
Natural-language intent and evidence truth remain human responsibilities and are not inferred from check counts.
External services and operating systems other than the release host are outside this local gate.
